evidence: apply_visible_range uses signed i64 viewport_start.saturating_sub(overscan), after clamping viewport_start and overscan individually nonnegative. SetVisibleRange start=0,count=10 with total_count=100,overscan=2 yields requested_start=-2 and requested_count=14 for a valid data interval [0,12). UiComponentStateRuntimeExt routes the event unchanged; showcase_demo_state projects requested fields. Existing overscan cases start=10.
impact_or_question: The data-source request projection exposes negative start and an inflated count near the first row, including an empty list with positive overscan.
next_action: Clamp requested_start to zero after subtraction; add first-row, start-less-than-overscan and empty-list cases; compare surface tree/table virtualization counterparts owned elsewhere.

evidence: Public UiComponentStateRuntimeExt::apply_event -> apply_component_event checks descriptor event support and passes event vectors unchanged. apply_world_transform checks scale <=0 only; NaN comparison is false so Vec3(scale) containing NaN is saved. apply_world_surface uses the same size positivity check. Position/rotation have no finite guard. complex_components.rs tests only finite positive and zero/negative values.
impact_or_question: Direct in-process typed world events can place NaN or infinite geometry in retained component state while reporting success.
next_action: Validate all world vectors and numeric surface parameters before writes; add NaN/Infinity typed-event rejection and unchanged-state-on-error contracts.

evidence: apply_commit sets renamed_node_id/renamed_text/rename_committed then clears temporary fields; it never updates node source arrays. Component tree tests only assert these result fields. Workspace rg across runtime/editor/interface/app found rename result declarations/writes/assertions and no explicit consumer of successful results.
impact_or_question: Where does the stable node ID plus committed label become a source-data rename and persistence transaction? A host may consume generic Commit dynamically, but its ownership contract is not located here.
next_action: Identify the authorized host/data-source consumer, document receipt consumption and add a source-label/persistence acceptance case; do not infer a bug from static absence alone.
